'''Grannin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|Mantellian Separatist]] during the [[Separatist War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], which was backing the [[Ord Mantell Central Authority|Mantellian Government]]. He was stationed in the [[Separatist Base]] on [[Mannett Point]] when a [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|promising Republic trooper]] [[Mission to Mannett Point (Havoc Squad)|infiltrated]] the base. He was encountered wounded by the trooper along with his Separatist fellows, but the trooper let them go under the condition that they'd fight no more.
